about: Material cards for simulation. Units MPa. tag: assumed (typical values, not yet matched to a print) or calibrated (fitted to the user's printed test bars). strength_mpa is along the layers; across_layers_factor scales it for loads that pull layers apart.

petg_printed_assumed.notes: Typical printed PETG, 3 walls / 15 % infill treated as solid: stiffness and strength are optimistic for thick, mostly-infill sections. Replace with calibrated values after the bar test.
